ruleDefinitions.name: Curl Web Request With Potential Custom User-Agent
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects execution of "curl.exe" with a potential custom "User-Agent". Attackers can leverage this to download or exfiltrate data via "curl" to a domain that only accept specific "User-Agent" strings

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\curl\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "curl\.exe") AND (process_command_line = RGX("\s-H\s") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*User\\-Agent\\:.*")))
